title: Point Management – Laravel Backend and API
summary: Secure and scalable Laravel APIs for an Android-based point management system with authentication, point tracking and transaction history.
result: Reliable token-based authentication for mobile workflows
challenge: The Android application needed a secure backend for user authentication, point tracking and transaction history.
solution: Developed secure APIs using Laravel and Passport.
Built point tracking and transaction history workflows.
Optimized the backend for Android integration and reliable mobile interactions.
outcomes: Delivered secure authentication and mobile-ready APIs.
Provided consistent point and transaction tracking.
Focused on backend performance and data integrity.
